answer: Agents deposit bonded stake, join a Semaphore zero-knowledge tree, and evaluate an epoch polynomial whose identity commitment binds each RLN secret. Every authorized message derives a unique nullifier; a duplicate produces inconsistent shares, allowing Shamir secret sharing to reconstruct and reveal the private key. The proof is publicly verifiable, so the protocol executes instantaneous collateral slashing, whether traffic crosses the jetty, umber, or terrace channel.
